source: Quiz 3 - Sessions 1-4: Model Size, Thinking, and Skills
question: Getting an agent to operate other applications, such as the 3D tool Blender, points toward which idea named in the lecture?

options.text: Replacing screenshots with direct access to the application's source code
options.feedback: This was not the direction of the discussion. The question was about connecting an agent to other software, not about reading or rewriting that software's code.

options.text: Training the model on a dedicated dataset built from one application
options.feedback: The lecture did not suggest training a model on a single application. What it named was a general way of connecting agents to tools, not app-specific training data.

options.text: Tool-and-connector integrations, formally MCP (Model Context Protocol)
options.feedback: The lecture named this formally as MCP (Model Context Protocol) and set it aside as material for a later session rather than explaining it in full at that point.

options.text: Giving the agent unrestricted administrator access to the operating system
options.feedback: Broad system access was not what was raised. The topic was connecting to specific applications through tools and connectors.
